clips.title: The story
paras: A Prairie Alpha Tooth is taken from the fierce pack leaders roaming the plains around Thunder Bluff. In tauren tradition, these teeth serve as a potent offering to cleanse and honor the land's precious water sources.

The water wells of Mulgore are vital lifelines for the tauren, and maintaining their spiritual purity demands rites of respect and sacrifice. To cleanse the Wildmane Well, Mull Thunderhorn of Bloodhoof Village requires teeth gathered from the prairie wolf alphas that stalk the shadow of Thunder Bluff. As apex predators of the rolling grassy plains, these alphas represent the raw strength of the wild. Offering their teeth honors the balance between hunter, prey, and the spirits of the earth.
